issue.title: Cached local agent listings omit a second launch after the index is populated
issue.description: Proposing bead: sase-1lh.7.5.4.3.3.2 note #1. The default cached listing was introduced by 8efecdd7390 (closed sase-xe.1). Existing sase-1b3 is a different whole fleet snapshot freeze; sase-zu.8 repairs revalidating TUI history and is closed. Do not treat the synthetic omission as proof all production launches fail: trace the second-launch lifecycle that the phase observed and add a production-path regression. Root cause of the missed mutation remains unknown; size large.

task_type_fields.impact: Newly launched or rapidly completed agents can be invisible to CLI consumers. Investigate launch/index invalidation and freshness selection without adding archive-wide scans to every poll. Current TUI parity fixes are not proof this CLI path is current.
task_type_fields.repro: At sase 2dd7fe7f8e, build_synthetic_agent_archive(artifact_count=24), then write_completed_artifact(projects_root,-1) without rebuilding. With SASE_HOME pointed at that fixture, listing_snapshot(include_full_history=True) omits the new artifact; scan_agent_artifacts sees it and listing_snapshot(include_full_history=True,index_freshness="revalidate") sees it. Output: cached_has_new=false, source_has_new=true, revalidated_has_new=true. Phase .2 independently observed the actual second tutorial sase run missing from agent list -a -j and added an on-disk agent_meta fallback.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1lh.7.5.4.3.3.2 note #1 reported this while repairing the tutorial harness; landing independently reproduced the post-index omission. No matching task or causally active epic owns the original CLI default.
